Initial release of cost-tracker — an AI spending monitor for OpenRouter.

- Track AI costs per model with daily, weekly, and monthly reports
- Set monthly budget limits and receive alerts at 80% usage
- Analyze spending across models with historical tracking in SQLite
- Get savings recommendations to optimize model selection
- Export usage data as JSON or CSV for further analysis
